description: Frozen, immutable evaluation dataset comprising experiments EXP-001 through EXP-080. Consists of 70 fault injection experiments across 4 target services and 5 fault types, plus 10 NO_FAULT control experiments.

notes.controls: The 10 NO_FAULT experiments are retained for anomaly-detection baseline analysis, but root-cause classification models must not treat NO_FAULT as an ordinary service root cause.
notes.target_leakage_prohibition: Heuristic RCA predictions, heuristic confidence scores, and ground truth labels are strictly prohibited from being used as model input features.
